title: BIR Form No. 2200-T — Excise Tax Return for Tobacco, Heated Tobacco and Vapor Products

choice_rows.label: Item 12 — Availing of tax relief under a Special Law/International Tax Treaty?

validation.how: Field label turns red; messages list in a 'Needs review' section after Part III (first 20 only), and Queue for submission is disabled while any error exists.

findings.now: Item 1 month is a row of 12 outline buttons (Jan to Dec).
findings.why: The official form uses a month select (frm2200T:txtMonth1, BIR-Form2200Tv2020.hta:413), and 12 options are far past the 4-option limit for buttons.

options.name: Select dropdown
options.detail: A plain Jan to Dec select, the same control the official form uses.

findings.now: The month comes from the library tile, yet the 12 month buttons stay active; a changed month saves as a second draft while the tile keeps reopening the old one.
findings.why: Drafts are looked up and saved by period (queueable_forms.rs:43-47 and the upsert select_row in db/queueable.rs:144-154), so changing the period on the page creates a new row.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the tile's month as a chip; a different month means opening that month's own tile.

options.name: Combobox with warning
options.detail: Keep the month editable in a combobox and warn that saving moves the draft to the new month.

findings.now: Errors only turn labels red and list at the bottom under Needs review, and Queue for submission is disabled with no message beside it.
findings.why: The list sits after Part III and stops at 20 messages, so the blocking item is not visible from the button.

options.name: Inline message
options.detail: Show the official alert text under the field it concerns.

options.name: Summary above the body
options.detail: Show the Needs review list above Part I with a link to each item.

findings.now: Queue for submission queues the return at once; the official final-copy prompt 'Please ensure that you have INTERNET access and a VALID email address is indicated in your tax return. Are you sure you want to submit?' never appears.
findings.why: The official final-copy step asks for confirmation (BIR-Form2200Tv2020.hta:6404, validations.json 2200t-final-038), and mark_submitted has no equivalent step.

options.name: Confirm dialog
options.detail: Show the official two-line text with OK and Cancel before the queue call.

options.name: Inline confirmation
options.detail: Show the same text above the Queue button and require a second click.

findings.now: Print preview draws the August 2022 sheet for a January 2020 return.
findings.why: The preview is registered as '2200t-2022', while no January 2020 sheet is pinned and the August 2022 PDF must not be merged into January 2020 rules (rules/forms/2200t-v2020/gaps.md:4).

options.name: Label the preview
options.detail: Put 'August 2022 sheet, not the January 2020 form' in the preview title.

options.name: Hide until pinned
options.detail: Disable Print preview until a January 2020 sheet is pinned.

findings.now: The input-phase date alerts that the official form raises when leaving the date field are never shown.
findings.why: validations.json lists 'Please provide a valid date. (MM/DD/YYYY format)', 'This date cannot be a future date.' and 'This date cannot be prior to 2018.' as input-phase alerts, and the model emits only validate-phase text (form_2200t.rs:974-996).

options.name: Blur checks
options.detail: Run the three input checks when Item 1 loses focus and show the verbatim text under the field.

options.name: Validate-time list
options.detail: Add the verbatim texts to Needs review without a blur check.

findings.now: A blank email shows 'Enter the email address BIR sends the filing confirmation to (Item 9).', which no official alert uses.
findings.why: The text is not in BIR-Form2200Tv2020.hta, so the filer sees wording eBIRForms never shows.

options.name: Keep as app note
options.detail: Keep the check but mark it as an app rule, not an official alert.

options.name: Remove
options.detail: Rely on the official final-copy email warning instead.

findings.now: A negative amount that rounds to zero displays and uploads as 0.00.
findings.why: The official amtFormat uses toFixed(2), which keeps the sign ('-0.00'), but official_amount drops it when the cents round to zero (official_xml.rs:493-497).

options.name: Match toFixed
options.detail: Keep the minus sign for any negative input, as amtFormat does.

options.name: Clamp in calculation
options.detail: Round tiny negatives to zero in the calculation and document the deviation.
